body:
#### PR description:

Title says it all. Also add the new variables in the HLT nano (and corresponding DQM).
In order to so, I have to support writing out ParT scores to jet value maps (commit 01bc0ace7f6daf3519d76cc1ff74928daf9519f1) to be consumed in the HLT nano module.

#### PR validation:

Run successfully `runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt` (and verified the new variables get filled).
